cases.question: How many customers are there?

cases.question: Which customers are from Canada?

cases.question: List all product categories.

cases.question: How many orders are there in each status?

cases.question: What is the most expensive product?

cases.question: How many customers do we have in each country?

cases.question: Which books cost less than $40?

cases.question: What is the average list price of products in each category?

cases.question: How many customers signed up in 2025?

cases.question: How many orders were placed in March 2025?
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) = 3 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025 LIMIT 1001

cases.question: What is our total revenue?
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items AS oi INNER JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' LIMIT 1001

cases.question: What is the total revenue for each product category?
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category LIMIT 1001

cases.question: Who are the top 5 customers by total spend?
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spend FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: How many orders came from each country?
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(o.order_id) AS num_orders FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY num_orders DESC LIMIT 1001

cases.question: How many units of each product have been sold in completed orders?
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_sold FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE orders.status = 'completed' GROUP BY product_id LIMIT 1001

cases.question: Show 2025 revenue by month number (1 to 12), in month order.
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) AS month_number, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) ORDER BY month_number LIMIT 1001

cases.question: What is the average order value of completed orders?
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT AVG(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS avg_order_value FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' LIMIT 1001

cases.question: Which products have never been ordered?

cases.question: Which customers have never placed an order?
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL LIMIT 1001

cases.question: Which customers have had at least one order refunded?
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'refunded' LIMIT 1001

cases.question: What percentage of all orders were cancelled or refunded? Return a number between 0 and 100.
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(oi.order_id), 2) AS cancelled_percentage FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id LIMIT 1001

cases.question: For each category, which product sold the most units in completed orders? Include ties.
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT p.category, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category, p.name ORDER BY p.category, total_sold DESC LIMIT 1001

cases.question: How many customers have bought products from at least three different categories in completed orders?
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS num_customers FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) >= 3 LIMIT 1001

cases.question: Which country has the highest revenue per customer, counting only customers who placed a completed order?
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS revenue_per_customer FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue_per_customer DESC LIMIT 1001

cases.question: How many order line items were sold below the product's current list price?
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS below_list_price_count FROM order_items WHERE unit_price < (SELECT unit_price FROM products WHERE product_id = order_items.product_id) LIMIT 1001

cases.question: How many customers placed more than 5 orders?
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS num_customers FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 5 LIMIT 1001

cases.question: Which completed order had the highest total value, and who placed it?
cases.predicted_sql: SELECT c.name, oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_value FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.name, oi.order_id ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: For each customer who has ordered, what was the date of their first order?
